hook: Childers moved from Fortune 20 operations, Amazon's peak IT infrastructure and GE's global virtualization program, into the CIO seat at a precision aerospace manufacturer. His IoT initiative at Meyer Tool, measuring machine productivity and availability on the factory floor, is the kind of applied industrial AI that rarely makes headlines but represents the actual frontier of operational technology in advanced manufacturing.
name: Vern Childers

quote.text: As a change agent who creates a dynamic, responsive, and business-driven IT organization, he has led several groundbreaking initiatives for the company.

timeline.event: Operations and engineering roles at Matsushita, Inacom, and eCampus
timeline.impact: Builds IT operations and engineering foundation
Applies architecture expertise to energy sector

timeline.event: Global Virtualization Program Leader, GE Corporate
timeline.impact: Leads enterprise virtualization at global scale
Manages peak IT infrastructure; recognized as North America Q4 IT Peak Leader three consecutive years
Leads all technology and launches IoT program for aerospace manufacturing

quick_facts: Chief Information Officer at Meyer Tool and Meyer Digital, a leading aerospace and gas turbine engine component manufacturer
Previously IT Manager at Amazon, recognized as North America's Q4 IT Peak Leader for three consecutive years (2012, 2013, 2014)
Global Virtualization Program Leader at GE Corporate
Holds GE Lean Six Sigma certification with Green Belt and Black Belt credentials
Launched a pioneering IoT initiative at Meyer Tool focused on machine productivity, availability, and downtime reduction

achievements.title: CIO, Meyer Tool and Meyer Digital
achievements.impact: Leads all technology, software development, and IT infrastructure for a leading aerospace and gas turbine engine component manufacturer.

achievements.title: IoT initiative, Meyer Tool
achievements.impact: Launched a groundbreaking IoT program tracking machine productivity, availability, and downtime, applying operational technology to precision manufacturing.

achievements.title: North America Q4 IT Peak Leader, Amazon, three consecutive years
achievements.impact: Recognized for IT leadership during Amazon's highest-demand operational periods across 2012, 2013, and 2014.

achievements.title: Global Virtualization Program Leader, GE Corporate
